name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
instructions: Select the assistance weight, step onto the platform and kneel or stand on it, then grip the bar overhead.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Reduce the assistance as you get stronger.
image_prompt_scene: Kneeling on the assist platform of an assisted pull-up machine, both hands gripping the overhead pull-up bar, arms fully extended overhead, body hanging straight.
